name: Trust/IOLTA Balance Alerts

parameters.content:
## Trust/IOLTA Balance Alerts

### How it works

1. The workflow runs daily and weekly scheduled triggers to check trust and IOLTA balances for open matters.
2. It fetches matter data from an external system and processes trust balances to determine alert tiers.
3. Alert-worthy trust balances trigger email alerts after compliance checks and potential partner escalations are logged and notified.
4. Negative balances cause escalations with separate email notifications for partners.
5. Weekly trust health rollup gathers summary data across all matters and sends accounting review emails.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure credentials for Clio API in the HTTP request nodes for data fetching.
- [ ] Set up email sending credentials for the emailSend nodes to deliver alerts.
- [ ] Ensure the sub-workflows invoked for compliance checks and escalation logging are present and properly configured.

### Customization

Customize alert thresholds and email content in the respective code nodes for tier computation and email building steps to suit organizational policies.

## Daily trigger and data fetch

Daily scheduled trigger initiates the workflow and fetches open matters with trust balances from Clio API.

## Trust balance processing

Processes fetched matter data to split records, compute trust balance alert tiers, and filter alert-worthy matters.

## Trust alert preparation and compliance

Builds trust alert emails and runs compliance checks before final approval for sending alerts.

## Send or skip trust alert email

Sends trust balance alert emails if approved or skips if recipients opted out.

## Negative balance escalation process

Handles matters with negative trust balances by building escalation emails, logging for audit, and sending partner escalation emails or skipping escalation.

## Weekly trigger and data fetch

Weekly scheduled trigger starts the trust health rollup process and fetches all matters for summary.

## Weekly trust health summary and email

Computes weekly trust health summary, builds the summary email, and sends it to accounting for review.

nodes.name: When Daily at 7am
nodes.notes: Runs daily, 7am by default.

nodes.name: Fetch Open Matters With Trust Balance
nodes.notes: Requests trust_balance directly on the Matters endpoint -- confirm this field name against your Clio API version before relying on it live (see the workflow doc sticky).

nodes.name: Split Matters Into Items
nodes.notes: Clio wraps list responses in a 'data' array — this unwraps it so downstream nodes get one matter per item.

nodes.name: Calculate Trust Balance Alert Tier
nodes.notes: LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD and ALERT_COOLDOWN_DAYS control tiering and re-alert frequency -- a matter that worsens from low to negative always alerts immediately regardless of cooldown.

nodes.name: Filter Matters For Alerts
nodes.notes: Reads from its own input directly (not by name) -- unlike this catalog's digest templates, each surviving item here is emailed individually, not aggregated into one summary, so there's no downstream node that needs to always run regardless of count.

nodes.name: Build Alert Email For Trust Balance
nodes.notes: One email per alert-worthy matter, with the full balance and matter detail. Falls back to FIRM_EMAIL if FIRM_TRUST_ACCOUNTING_EMAIL isn't set, so the guardrail call never fails on a missing recipient.

nodes.name: Run Compliance Workflow For Alert
nodes.notes: This template inherits OPS1 per its ticket, even though every recipient is firm staff, not a client -- the opt-out/disclaimer checks are effectively inert here, but the audit log entry is still valuable for a compliance-grade template like this one.

nodes.name: If Alert Is Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result.

nodes.name: Send Trust Balance Alert Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Trust Balance Alert Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Alert For Opted-Out Recipient
nodes.notes: Rare for an internal accounting recipient, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Trust Balance Is Negative
nodes.notes: Only a negative balance triggers immediate partner escalation -- a low (but still positive) balance only goes to the accounting alert above.

nodes.name: Build Partner Escalation Email
nodes.notes: Escalates directly to the managing partner -- a negative trust balance never waits for the accounting alert's cooldown logic. Falls back to FIRM_EMAIL if FIRM_PARTNER_EMAIL isn't set, so the guardrail call never fails on a missing recipient.

nodes.name: Run Audit Workflow For Escalation
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging -- this goes to the firm's own managing partner, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same internal-notification pattern used elsewhere in this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Partner Escalation Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Partner Escalation Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Partner Escalation
nodes.notes: Not a negative balance -- no partner escalation needed, the accounting alert above already covers a low balance.

nodes.name: When Weekly Monday at 8am
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Monday 8am by default.

nodes.name: Fetch All Matters For Weekly Rollup
nodes.notes: Same Matters endpoint as the daily check, but every open matter regardless of balance tier.

nodes.name: Calculate Weekly Trust Health Summary
nodes.notes: LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD matches the daily check's tiering — same threshold used for consistency.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Trust Health Email
nodes.notes: Internal accounting summary — no guardrail wrap needed, matching this catalog's other weekly rollups. Falls back to FIRM_EMAIL if FIRM_TRUST_ACCOUNTING_EMAIL isn't set.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Trust Health Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed.

main.node: Fetch Open Matters With Trust Balance
Build Alert Email For Trust Balance
Fetch All Matters For Weekly Rollup

description: Runs daily: pulls every open matter's trust balance from Clio, tiers each as negative/low/healthy, and alerts the firm's trust accounting contact for anything negative or low -- with a cooldown so an unresolved balance doesn't re-alert every day (a worsening tier always alerts immediately regardless). A negative balance also immediately escalates to the managing partner. Separately, a weekly rollup reports every open matter's balance for accounting's own review. Never moves money or makes an accounting decision -- balance reporting and alerting only. Replaces PM accounting add-ons for trust monitoring.
